status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/asset-tracker/proposed_items.json. Sources are named, never read here; 'source unknown' carries the question that would find one.

gaps.name: Asset (a tracked machine with tag, line, Fiix id and purchase lineage)
gaps.ontology_today: No curated Asset type; only the generated not_served types RelPublicAppEquipment and RelPublicAppEquipmentAsset.

gaps.name: Portal equipment relations through the reporting API
gaps.ontology_today: public.app_equipment, public.app_equipment_asset and public.app_maintenance_work_order are not approved relations, so no record is readable.

gaps.name: Fiix MACMMS asset register
gaps.ontology_today: No Fiix reader; the only Fiix key the Workbench could see is app_equipment_asset.fiix_asset_id, which is not served.
gaps.open_question: Does PLX have read-only API access to Fiix (petra-hygienic.macmms.com) for its asset list, and is the asset register owned by the tracker workbook or by Fiix?

gaps.name: Tracker workbook at the submission-date revision
gaps.ontology_today: The current revision is pinned but its body read is not proven; the submission-date revision is unfetched (gap-c6eac8f2325d).

sources.relation: Operations site, CM Operations Files, version history

gaps.name: CapitalizationDecision and its approver (the CFO)
gaps.ontology_today: No decision object; MCApproval and the not_served RelPublicAppApprovalRecord are generic and carry no capital/expense type.
gaps.open_question: Where does the CFO record a capitalize-versus-expense decision for an equipment purchase (Sage, BC, mail, the tracker or elsewhere), who is the CFO contact, and what threshold applies?

gaps.name: PurchaserClassification (new / replacement / repair) and its classifier
gaps.ontology_today: No such attribute or object; no classification field found on the Portal PurchaseOrder or PurchaseRequisition models.
gaps.open_question: Where does the purchaser record new, replacement or repair for an equipment purchase: a tracker column, the PO or requisition, or mail?

gaps.name: Asset to Purchase lineage (asset -> PO / receipt / purchase invoice)
gaps.ontology_today: Purchase objects exist (Sage PO relations served, BC purchase invoices, Portal POs) but no link to an asset; the brief reports no invoice or Sage key in the tracker.
gaps.open_question: Which key, if any, ties a tracker asset to its Sage PO or invoice or its BC purchase invoice (asset tag on the PO line, invoice number in the tracker, something else)?

gaps.name: Sage AP invoice and G/L coding
gaps.ontology_today: The reporting API serves Sage PO and order relations but no AP or G/L relation, so vendor-versus-invoice coding is unreadable.
gaps.open_question: Which Sage AP or G/L tables hold the coding of equipment invoices, and can the reporting API serve them read-only?

gaps.name: Asset to production line
gaps.ontology_today: No line object link; line data sits in not_served Portal columns.

gaps.name: Purchase as grant Cost Line (funder-claim edge)
gaps.ontology_today: No grant, Cost Line or funder-claim object or link.
gaps.open_question: Where are grant claims and their cost lines recorded (funder portal exports, a workbook, Sage), and which purchase key do they carry?

gaps.name: Business Central fixed assets
gaps.ontology_today: The GET-only BC grammar names no fixed-asset entity set.
gaps.open_question: Does PLX use Business Central Fixed Assets (or plan to) for capitalized equipment, and in which of the three companies?
